description:
The image depicts a bathroom with a white bathtub, shower, and gray countertop.

*   A white bathtub is positioned in the foreground, accompanied by:
    *   A silver shower head mounted on the wall above the bathtub.
    *   A silver soap dish situated on the left side of the bathtub.
*   The bathtub is connected to a shower faucet with a silver handle.
*   A large mirror is mounted on the wall adjacent to the bathtub, featuring a silver handle on the right side
